entities.name: Carbon tetrabromide
observations: The first reactant decodes as carbon tetrabromide, CBr4.
It is consistent with bromide delivery in an Appel alcohol-to-alkyl-bromide conversion.

entities.name: Triphenylphosphine
observations: PPh3 is the canonical co-reagent with CBr4 for Appel bromination of alcohols.
It may be omitted from atom-mapped reaction SMILES because it is not incorporated into the product.

entities.name: Primary alcohol to alkyl bromide
observations: The terminal primary alcohol in CCCC N(C)C(=O)COCCCO is converted to the corresponding 3-bromopropyl ether, CCCC N(C)C(=O)COCCCBr.
The amide and internal ether functionalities remain unchanged.
The assignment is a textbook-based inference; no exact empirical ORD record was found.
